'''Cheese''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who led a group of [[Tunnel Rats]] in [[Tolea Biqua]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], she oversaw their interrogation of the captured [[Believers|Believer]], [[Rydna]]. She was taller than most members of her [[Species/Legends|species]]. She also wore a necklace that constantly emitted [[Perfume/Legends|perfume]], making her smell of wildflowers.
